steps: Area ABE = 54 + 9 = 63 cm². Because E is the midpoint of AC, the whole area ABC is 126 cm².
ABP and APE share a height to BE, so BP:PE = 54:9.
Write u = area BDP and v = area DPE. These triangles also share a height to BE, giving u/v = 54/9.
Triangles ADE and CDE have equal bases AE and CE and the same height from D. Each has area 9 + v.
Partition ABC into ABP, BDP, ADE and CDE: 126 = 54 + u + 2(9 + v). Thus u + 2v = 54.
The required area is u = 54²/(54 + 2 × 9) = 81/2 cm². No side ratio for D was needed.
